core_meaning.primary_meaning: Firoz is a Persian-origin name meaning “Victorious”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firoz corresponds to the Persian form فيروز (Persian فیروز (Fīrūz)). Its core sense is turquoise. Firoz is a South Asian spelling of the Persian name فیروز (Fīrūz) 'victorious', also the source of the word for the turquoise gem. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source record gave أحمد (Ahmad) as the Arabic form of firoz and أحمد as its Urdu form — a completely different name. That has been corrected here; firoz must not be merged with Ahmad.
